description_en: Removes a multicast source from a multicast group if you no longer need the multicast source to send multicast traffic
description_zh: 如果您不需要某个组播源再发送组播流量，您可以调用DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口将该组播源从组播组中删除
name: DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multicast domain to which the multicast source belongs
parameters.name: transit_router_multicast_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the multicast group to which the multicast source belongs
parameters.help_zh: 组播源所属的组播组的IP地址
parameters.name: group_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the multicast sources
parameters.name: network_interface_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the multicast source is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除组播源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除组播源
parameters.name: dry_run
